name: Go version
meaning: The Go toolchain that built the compiler.

name: OS
meaning: The operating system the compiler is built for.

name: Architecture
meaning: The processor architecture the compiler is built for.

name: Module version
meaning: The version of the STEGO module.

name: VCS
meaning: The version control system of the source.

name: Revision
meaning: The commit the compiler is built from.

name: Source state
meaning: Whether the source had changes that were not committed.
